rationale: Fixed before any R3 outcome using eight paired train-only no-update populations at initialization and unchanged RI-last. Balanced combined auxiliary gradient / MSE gradient median: Response 0.0852 init and 0.3963 RI-last; Graph 0.0700 init and 0.1921 RI-last. RI-last Response per-batch range 0.1517–0.8427, so stronger exactly doubles both coefficients rather than changing their ratio or removing safeguards. Initialization A and U gradients oppose (mean 148 degrees on Response); the 10:1 coefficient ratio and 30-update warmup limit early dispersion pressure. RI-last auxiliary/joint mean angle near 90 degrees supplies a distinct signal. These raw-gradient observations do not predict Muon/AdamW update effects; success still requires matched representation stability/discrimination, distillation signal and validation prediction utility. No rank/cosine target, test-set tuning, or change to EMA, sampler, architecture and original objectives.
